name: Onii-tan to Pishuton Gokko!
original_name: おにいたんとぴしゅとんごっこ!
source:
Claire-chan and Ruka-chan are bestest friends. One day at the park they meet a bigger boy who lets them come play at his house. They call him "onii-tan". He has lots of friends and they all want to play grownup games with Claire-chan and Ruka-chan... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE104304.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
克莱尔酱与露卡酱是最要好的朋友。一天在公园，她们遇见一个年长男孩，男孩邀请她们去家里玩。她们叫他“哥哥”。他有许多朋友，他们都想和克莱尔酱、露卡酱玩成年人的游戏……

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE104304.html]DLsite English[/url]]
